summary: Attempt-2 remediation inflates validator substantive_loc to 11513, but ~9935 lines (86%) are repetitive reference JSON catalogs that load during case ingest yet do not change published artifacts; mutating or truncating every catalog leaves summary.json byte-identical. The honest behavior-bearing analyze path remains a ~1279-line Python pipeline (cli -> pipeline -> loaders/solver/report plus fluid/regime/mesh/convergence helpers) over three cases, with six additional Python modules unreachable and several reachable modules computing discarded side values. Core physics formulas are credible engineering estimators, but PADDING_RISK is HIGH and honest reachable runtime/config LOC still sits near ~1560, below the large_system_strict >=3000 floor.

evidence.observation: Q6 requires independent reachability tracing, toy/padding judgment, removal-test reasoning, and for large_system_strict >=3000 substantive reachable solver-visible runtime/config LOC with no HIGH toy/padding risk.
Production authenticity rejects duplicated/dead/unreachable scale, micro-module inflation, and data volume that does not materially change operational behavior.

findings.why_it_matters: Roughly 86% of validator-counted environment LOC is repetitive reference JSON. Catalog APIs beyond load_reference_bundle are unused or side-effect-only, and published artifacts are invariant to wholesale catalog mutation or truncation. This is config-volume padding rather than production logic depth.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either wire catalog lookups into physical-state, limit selection, regime classification, or publication lineage so catalog edits change deterministic outputs, or replace bulk variant tables with smaller behavior-bearing catalogs consumed by multiple modules.
findings.regression_risk: Medium if wiring is cosmetic; low if catalogs become true cross-module inputs with tested invariants.

findings.why_it_matters: Honest behavior-bearing reachable runtime/config LOC is about 1560 (1279 reachable Python across 19 modules, ~250 JSON config/cases, ~30 shell/bin). That remains below the >=3000 floor even after the remediation expansion.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add additional coupled subsystems whose outputs and error paths are consumed by publication, not merely loaded or discarded, until reachable behavior-bearing LOC clears 3000 without clone modules or inert tables.
findings.regression_risk: Medium if new code duplicates existing one-pass formulas.

findings.why_it_matters: Six post-remediation Python modules (~261 LOC) are not imported from the analyze entrypoint closure. property_bridge duplicates fluid state logic with a catalog hook that never executes; publication_chain/lineage_digest duplicate revision helpers already present in report.py.
findings.minimal_remediation: Wire unreachable modules into loaders/solver/report or remove them; avoid parallel compute_state and publication_revision implementations.
findings.regression_risk: Low if integration is tested through publication artifacts.

findings.why_it_matters: correlation_report, envelope_score, extended_residual_summary quality_score, contract_summary, and fleet_risk_indices are invoked but their results are discarded, so instruction-facing fleet stress indices and catalog correlation means never reach outputs.
findings.minimal_remediation: Feed fleet_risk_indices through enrich_fleet_rollup into summary.json, incorporate catalog-backed property checks into compute_state or limits, and ensure correlation/envelope diagnostics affect findings or publication when required by the work request.
findings.regression_risk: Medium if only stdout side effects change without artifact contract updates.

findings.why_it_matters: Core physics modules implement credible single-pass estimators (ideal-gas vs liquid density, Colebrook/Haaland friction, laminar/transitional/turbulent Nusselt branches, mesh and convergence margins). The reachable core is real engineering logic but still behaves like a compact calculator over eight operating points rather than a large production analysis system.
findings.minimal_remediation: Deepen distinct computational subsystems with interacting state and failure semantics instead of adding lookup volume or duplicate helper modules.
findings.regression_risk: Low if determinism and publication schema are preserved.

role_output.SUBSTANTIVE_LOC_ASSESSMENT: Validator substantive_loc=11513 across environment/, but only ~1560 lines are honest behavior-bearing reachable runtime/config logic: ~1279 Python across 19 analyze-reachable modules (loaders 199, solver 135, report 117, models 102, reference_catalog 98, friction_models 65, heat_transfer 64, residual_trends 57, geometry_checks 56, cli 53, pipeline 46, correlation_suite 41, convergence 40, regime 37, envelope_scoring 36, fleet_indices 34, mesh 34, fluid 33, case_contract 31), plus ~250 JSON config/cases and ~30 shell/bin. ~9935 reference JSON lines (850 repetitive catalog rows) load in loaders but do not change published artifacts. Six modules (~261 LOC: property_bridge, publication_chain, lineage_digest, units_registry, severity_rules, hydraulic_head) are unreachable from bin/fluidlab analyze.
role_output.MAJOR_MODULES: cli.py — analyze/show-config entrypoints. pipeline.py — config/case load, per-case analyze_case, basic fleet rollup, artifact publish; fleet_risk_indices discarded. loaders.py — schema validation, digests, reference bundle preload. solver.py — mesh/convergence/residual side summaries, per-point compute_state->regime_metrics margin/findings; correlation/envelope/residual quality discarded. fluid.py — liquid thermal expansion vs ideal-gas density/velocity/Prandtl state. regime.py — Reynolds, Colebrook-style friction drop, Mach/CFL, Nusselt heat transfer. friction_models.py/heat_transfer.py — friction-factor and Nusselt branches used by regime. mesh.py/convergence.py — mesh score and residual/imbalance convergence gates feeding margins. report.py — deterministic JSON/CSV/checkpoint publication. reference_catalog.py/correlation_suite.py — catalog load and correlation means with no artifact effect. property_bridge.py/publication_chain.py/lineage_digest.py/units_registry.py/severity_rules.py/hydraulic_head.py — post-remediation modules not on analyze closure or duplicated elsewhere.
role_output.PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Patching only report publication_revision without lineage_digest/operating_point_keys leaves checkpoint lineage requirements unsatisfied. Fixing solver margins without reconciling fluid vs property_bridge catalog deltas ignores the intended catalog-backed property path. Adjusting correlation_registry rows will not change outputs until correlation_report feeds findings or metrics. Enabling fleet_risk_indices in code without enriching fleet_rollup in summary.json leaves instruction fleet-summary requirements unmet. Trimming catalog JSON alone preserves identical artifacts, masking padding from scale metrics.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing all five reference JSON catalogs (~9935 validator-counted lines) or truncating each to two entries leaves summary.json unchanged (verified). Removing unreachable modules property_bridge/publication_chain/lineage_digest/units_registry/severity_rules/hydraulic_head (~261 Python LOC) also leaves outputs unchanged. Removing correlation_suite, envelope_scoring side calls, fleet_risk_indices, and extended_residual_summary (~150 LOC of discarded work) leaves published artifacts unchanged. Deleting the core chain fluid+regime+friction_models+heat_transfer+solver margin logic (~300 LOC) collapses Mach/CFL/pressure/temperature findings and CSV metrics—the only behavior agents and verifier actually grade.
role_output.REQUIRED_CHANGES: Make reference catalogs and the six unreachable modules behavior-bearing on the analyze/publication path; stop counting inert catalog bulk toward production depth; integrate fleet stress indices and catalog-backed property/limit logic into published artifacts; expand honest reachable coupled runtime logic past the 3000-line floor without clone modules or discarded side computations.
